name: Selonabant
summary: Selonabant is a cannabinoid CB1 receptor antagonist which is under development for the treatment of acute cannabinoid intoxication. It was also previously being developed to treat obesity, but development for this indication was discontinued. The drug is administered by intravenous infusion. It dramatically reduced the subjective effects of Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) in a clinical trial.
